confirmed.text: The new product is a smaller, standalone Lifetide experience rather than another feature inside the current full product.
The core loop is short interview waves followed by immediate user-facing understanding, ending in three alternative life plans and continued conversation.
Resume, MBTI report and related material upload must remain available but optional.
The user-facing persona dashboard and full six-layer persona product are removed; a lightweight internal working memory remains for continuity and planning.
The intended audience is young adults, and the visual experience should feel fashionable, cool, modern, playful and less serious.
The implementation may be a full Next.js web product rather than a constrained H5 page.
Existing Lifetide visual assets may be reused when their provenance and license permit it.
Loom is the continuity and design-document infrastructure for this new workspace.
The previously documented Digital Tide / Nocturnal Editorial / Chromatic Ocean visual direction is incorrect.
The screenshot reference is neo-brutalist: visible grid, heavy ink outlines, hard offset shadows, high-contrast paper surfaces, editorial type and tactile press states.
The final style should remain modern, attractive to young adults and not become visually hostile or exhausting.
Green, blue or another color may be used as an accent rather than the entire interface palette.
The product should prefer a coherent ready-made UI library/style registry over inventing every visual primitive from scratch.
The product name is 人生试运行. It does not reuse the 潮生 or Lifetide product name.

The original Lifetide-Lite working tree and its current visual implementation are frozen as donor evidence; Harness and prompt redesign proceeds in the clean codex/conversational-harness-v1 worktree before any runtime code changes.
confirmed.source: user direction and inspected git worktrees

confirmed.text: The canonical interview is a continuous conversation with inline question cards and an always-available free-text composer; submitted cards fold into editable user bubbles.
AI controls wave mission, question wording, order, depth and follow-up proposals; the host controls schema, safety, question/wave limits, readiness, persistence, stop and recovery.
confirmed.source: user direction refined through architecture review

confirmed.text: Each wave contains 5-10 questions delivered in adaptive 1-3-question microbatches; the default is three waves, the hard maximum is five, and at most two eligible deep-dive waves count inside that maximum.

The six-dimension decision radar—traits, motivation, capabilities, relationships, environment and narrative—is the main breadth standard; runtime states are unseen, signaled, grounded, conflicted and declined with no score or percentage.
Runtime keeps exactly two model roles, Interviewer and Sensemaker; route, ordinary-day, prototype, blueprint and bounded chat are Sensemaker modes rather than autonomous Agents.
Three equal three-year lives and three-day reversible trials remain the product horizon; ordinary-day six-dimension screening and editable route intents precede formal plan generation.

The 5-10 per-wave standard applies to decision-relevant elicitation units. A normal wave asks 5-10 questions, but unsolicited user material may precover units with exact source mapping; actual questions remain capped at 10 and are never repeated merely to satisfy a quota.
confirmed.source: whole-system integrity review of user-directed card/free-text equivalence

confirmed.text: TASK-007's pre-code gate is documentation harmony, executable fixture/protocol specifications, structural prompt lint and Keeper pass; real-model Prompt v3 evaluation occurs after matching runtime surfaces exist and before prompt activation.
The canonical control plane is one XState v5 machine persisted with an atomic committed transition ledger and current snapshot; the product does not use full event sourcing.
Every derived source reference is an exact SourceRef containing logical source_id and immutable source_revision; edits create versions and transactionally stale the dependent closure.
Formal readiness and provisional permission are separate: waiver never satisfies formal readiness, and safety is never waivable.

ParallelLife keeps attractions, costs_and_tradeoffs and evidence_for; Prototype is a reusable plan, TrialInstance owns trial lifecycle, and insight lifecycle status is separate from language strength.

assumptions.text: The working product name is 潮生｜人生试玩 until naming is revisited after concept validation.

The first implementation will reuse infrastructure and licensed assets conceptually but will not share runtime code with the existing Lifetide repository until an explicit engineering decision is made.
Three-year alternative lives are a better consumer horizon than the source method's five-year Odyssey Plans; each route ends in a three-day reversible trial.

unresolved.question: Should anonymous progress persist only on-device, or should account creation be requested when users save plans or upload files?
unresolved.resolution: MVP starts without registration. A guest session uses an opaque HttpOnly session token and server-side temporary storage. Uploads are allowed after explicit model-processing consent and are automatically purged with the guest session after 24 hours. Account creation is requested only when the user wants cross-device continuation or retention beyond the guest window.

unresolved.question: Which exact existing sky backgrounds are user-owned and publishable outside the original Lifetide repository?
unresolved.resolution: Original user-provided sky backgrounds are excluded from Lifetide-Lite MVP. Only registry-backed CC0 water, boat and landmark assets may be copied with their license snapshot and checksum. Sky assets remain blocked unless written cross-project publication rights are later recorded.
